q: Write a detailed note on National Income?
a: Explain the terms; Gross National Product, Net National Product, and Gross Domestic Product? Answers: Definitions of National Income: The Labour and the Capital of a country acting on its natural resources, produce annually a certain net aggregate of commodities, material and immaterial, including services of all kinds. Explanation of National Income: The term "National Product" also means the net aggregate market cost of goods and services produced in a country in one year. National Product is called National Income when the repairing cost and depreciation of machines are deducted from it. According to the present ideas, National Income may be defined as the aggregate factor income, which arises from the current production of goods ty and services by the nation's economy. (K. K. Dewett.), Other Concepts: Gross National Product: It is defined as the total market value of all final cand services produced in a year. In a country. It is the measurement of the current output of the economic activities of the country. The agricultural product, the industrial product, and the services rendered by different people of the country are included in G.N.P. Net National Product: The capital goods like machinery, equipment, etc. are used to produce the goods during the year when we deduct their "wear and tear" charges and depreciation from Gross National Product; we get Net National Product. It means: N.N.P. = G.N.P – Depreciation. Gross Domestic Product The goods and services produced in a country, through the factors of production, in a year, need material. G.D.P. Includes only the goods produced within the country. It does - not include foreign production or imported goods.
